# AD558 - Complete 8-bit digital-to-analog converter with input latch, reference and output amplifier

Package DIP-16 · family AD · catalogue file [catalog/chips/AD558.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/AD558.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DB0 | input | data bit 0, least significant |
| 2 | DB1 | input | data bit 1 |
| 3 | DB2 | input | data bit 2 |
| 4 | DB3 | input | data bit 3 |
| 5 | DB4 | input | data bit 4 |
| 6 | DB5 | input | data bit 5 |
| 7 | DB6 | input | data bit 6 |
| 8 | DB7 | input | data bit 7, most significant |
| 9 | /CE | input | chip enable, active low; latch is open while /CE and /CS are both low |
| 10 | /CS | input | chip select, active low; same timing and function as /CE |
| 11 | VCC | power | +4.5 V to +16.5 V (+11.4 V min for the 10 V range) |
| 12 | GND | ground | digital ground |
| 13 | AGND | ground | analog ground |
| 14 | VOUTSELECT | analog | output range select: to VOUT for 0-2.56 V, to GND for 0-10 V (Figure 3) |
| 15 | VOUTSENSE | analog | feedback (sense) of the output amplifier |
| 16 | VOUT | analog | analog output voltage |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 16 | VOUT = code / 256 x full scale: 0-2.55 V on the 2.56 V range, 0-9.961 V on the 10 V range (code table page 9-38). The latch passes the data while /CE and /CS are both low and holds it from the rising edge of either (Table I, page 9-40). |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 8

Changes on: level: transparent while /CE and /CS are both low

- /CE low and /CS low: the latch follows DB0-DB7 (transparent)
- /CE or /CS goes high: the data present at the rising edge is held
- /CE or /CS high: previous data stays latched

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Digital inputs: logic 1 2.0 V min, logic 0 0.8 V max, 100 uA max input current. Output: source 5 mA; sink is a passive pull-down to ground (2 kohm on the 2.56 V range, 10 kohm on the 10 V range). Supply current 15 typ / 25 max mA. Settling to 1/2 LSB: 0.8 typ / 1.5 max us (2.56 V range), 2.0 / 3.0 us (10 V range) (page 9-36). |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| pulse width | /CE |  | 150 |
| setup | DB0 | /CE | 200 |
| hold | DB0 | /CE | 10 |

## Notes

Pin names are the ones in Figure 1 (page 9-37); both pin 12 and pin 13 are labelled GND there, pin 13 is the analog ground (block diagram page 9-35).

## Sources

- [Analog Devices AD558 DACPORT Low Cost Complete uP-Compatible 8-Bit DAC, in Analog Devices 1984 Data-Acquisition Databook Volume I (pages 9-35 to 9-42)](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/analogDevices/_dataBooks/1984_Analog_Devices_Data-Acquisition_Handbook_Volume_1_Integrated_Circuits.pdf) - 9-35 to 9-42 (PDF pages 451-458); AD558J/K
